subject: Vanguard: isolation evidence & operational asks (post-demo)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@vanguardhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vanguard: isolation evidence & operational asks (post-demo)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap + the asks we promised we’d consolidate:

Summary of what we heard (from the call)
- Primary requirement: strict data isolation for PHI and PII workloads.
- Must have tenant-level separation, KMS/HSM control for encryption keys, and exportable audit logs (immutable retention >= 1 year).
- Preference for private networking (VPC peering or dedicated network path); procurement will evaluate Dedicated capacity vs Private VPC/on-prem.

Actions we need from you to scope a proposal
1) Confirm whether Vanguard requires the control plane to be in your VPC (private control plane) or whether our private data plane (customer VPC + Redwood control plane) is acceptable.
2) Confirm key management preference: BYOK with HSM-backed keys, or Redwood-managed KMS with a customer key rotation SLA.
3) Any minimum RTO/RPO or rollback SLAs required for cutover (example: RTO < 4 hours).
4) List of stakeholders for security review + procurement timeline (names, emails).

I attached an isolation evidence checklist that maps items we can supply (SOC 2 artifacts, network diagrams, keystore residency options, audit log export examples). If you prefer, we can run a short technical workshop with your security/infra folks to walk through connectivity and the PoC plan.

Next steps (from our side)
- We can produce a Dedicated capacity proposal and a Private VPC proposal with the delta in operational changes and pricing once we get the answers above.
- Suggested timeline: technical workshop next week, then a tailored evidence package the week after.

Attachments: redwood-isolation-evidence-checklist.pdf (summary of evidence + PoC options)

Best,
Sean
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Park <elena@vanguardhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@vanguardhealth.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vanguard: isolation evidence & operational asks (post-demo)

Sean —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from security/procurement here:

1) Control plane: Our preference is that the control plane not store any customer data. Ideally we want a private data plane inside our VPC (VPC peering or PrivateLink) and the option for a private control plane (customer-managed) if needed for FedRAMP-ish customers.
2) KMS/HSM: BYOK with HSM-backed keys is a hard requirement for the initial scope.
3) Audit logs: immutable export to our S3 (write-once) for 12 months minimum.
4) RTO/RPO: We'll define a formal RTO requirement during procurement, but please assume we will ask for a 4-hour recovery window as a baseline.

Security would like the following evidence items in the package:
- Network isolation architecture diagram showing routing and egress controls.
- Proof that cache/ephemeral artifacts are scrubbed on session termination (or how you persist/evict KV caches).
- Sample audit log extract (anonymized) showing request metadata and model variant info.
- KMS/HSM attestation details and rotation procedures.

Procurement: we need a high-level delta in pricing between Dedicated and Private VPC up front so we can budget while security reviews the evidence.

I’ll loop in our infra lead (security@vanguardhealth.com) for the tech workshop scheduling.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Chief Technology Officer
Vanguard Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@vanguardhealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vanguard: isolation evidence & operational asks (post-demo)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the details — wanted to call out what we can prepare quickly and what typically requires a short PoC.

Quick evidence we can provide in 3–5 business days:
- SOC 2 Type II summary and control mappings (redacted).
- Network isolation diagram templates and our standard VPC peering/PrivateLink patterns.
- Anonymized audit-log sample (CSV/JSON) and retention options.
- KMS/HSM integration description and attestation summary (how BYOK works with HSM import or external HSM).

Items usually validated during a PoC (1–2 weeks):
- KV cache eviction/sanitization proof points (we can run a live test and share logs).
- Full control-plane residency test if you require customer-managed control plane (that requires coordination with infra teams and a short staging build).

Operational questions for you
- Do you have a preferred peering method (AWS Transit Gateway vs VPC peering vs PrivateLink)?
- Any strict egress IP allowlists that will affect our support access?
- For BYOK, do you plan to bring keys via AWS KMS import, Azure Key Vault, or an on-prem HSM?

We can scope two deliverables: (A) a Dedicated-capacity PoC where we reserve a GPU pool in our region and run sample jobs with audit logging to your S3, and (B) a Private VPC PoC that includes VPC peering and BYOK. We'll put rough pricing deltas in the next email once you confirm the preferred PoC path.

If it helps, I can schedule a 60-minute tech workshop next Tuesday with our infra engineer (Marissa) and solutions team to walk security through the checklist.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com

From: Elena Park <elena@vanguardhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vanguard: isolation evidence & operational asks (post-demo)

Laura —

Thanks — that timeline works. A few quick answers:
- Preferred peering: AWS Transit Gateway (we use TGW across accounts).
- Egress allowlist: we will provide a CIDR allowlist for support access; anything outside that will need explicit approval.
- BYOK path: AWS KMS import is preferred; we can discuss HSM if required for specific customers.

Procurement asks: can you include in the delta pricing a recurring premium for Private VPC control plane isolation (if you need to stand up a private control plane per-customer) and an estimate for one-time onboarding engineering hours (we expect to track that separately). Also: what is your standard cutoff/rollback plan for switching from Dedicated to Private mid-pilot? We need the RTO/RPO commitments so we can size our internal risk.

I’ll get our infra lead to propose two windows for the tech workshop (Tue/Thu next week).

Best,
Elena

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@vanguardhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vanguard: isolation evidence & operational asks (post-demo)

Elena —

Great — thanks for the quick answers and the TGW preference. Action items and next steps from Redwood:

1) Evidence package (deliverable by EOD Friday): SOC2 summary, anon audit-log sample, network isolation diagram (TGW pattern), KMS-byok integration notes. (Attachment: redwood-isolation-evidence-checklist.pdf)
2) Pricing delta: rough-stamp premium for Private control plane + one-time onboarding estimate (we’ll include line items for engineering hours). Expect a ballpark in the evidence package; final numbers after PoC scoping.
3) PoC options: Dedicated PoC (fast, 1 week) or Private VPC PoC (2–3 weeks with TGW peering and BYOK).
4) Rollback strategy: we can commit to a documented cutover and rollback runbook; baseline RTO target we can sign up to during contract negotiation is 4 hours for service failover (dependent on model footprint). We’ll include a draft runbook with the evidence package.

Scheduling: I’ll book the technical workshop once your infra lead confirms a slot — linking my calendar here: https://calendar.example.com/sean/30min

If you can send the security stakeholder list and procurement timeline, we’ll prioritize the artifacts and pricing.

Thanks,
Sean
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
